swallowing errors without context.

factualBlock:
An SLO defines a reliability target; the error budget is
the allowed unreliability within that target. It creates a
quantitative trade-off between shipping speed and
reliability work.

exampleBlocks.text:
SLO 99.9% successful requests over 30 days ->
0.1% error budget.

excludedAdviceBlocks.text:
Choose user-relevant indicators, not vanity uptime metrics.
Explain it aloud before swiping. 310 / 310

excludedInterviewBlocks.text:
SLOs turn reliability into an explicit product target; error
budgets help decide when to prioritize stability over
feature velocity.

excludedMnemonicBlocks.text:
If the train promises 99.9% on-time service, the
small allowed delay budget cannot be spent
carelessly in week one.
